"2. Amendment of regulation 4.- In the Karnataka Public Service Commission (Conditions of
Service) Regulations, 1957, in regulation 4, in clause (1) :-

(i) for sub-clause (i) except the provisos the following shall be substituted and shall
be deemed to have been substituted with effect from the 1st day of January 2016,
namely :-

(i) The Chairman shall receive a pay of two lakh twenty five thousand rupees and
each of the other Member shall receive a pay of two lakh five thousand one hundred
rupees with effect from 1st day of January 2016.

(ii) after sub clause (i), the following shall be inserted, namely :-
(ia) The pay of the Chairman and Members of the Commission shall be as specified
by the State Government from time to time after approval of the State Cabinet :
(1577)

OBL BANOS T2B, BS, DBT, 2O, WHO, [098 een &
Provided that, the pay of the Chairman shall not exceed the pay scale of the Chief
Secretary and the pay of the Members shall not exceed the Maximum Pay Scale of All
India Service Officers not below the rank of Principal Secretary to Government."

"(ii) The Chairman and other Members shall be entitled to draw Dearness
Allowance and City Compensatory Allowance at the rates applicable to the highest
class of State Government servant from time to time."
